name: American Express Green Card

tripDelay.notes: Covered reasons include inclement weather, equipment failure, lost/stolen passport, terrorist action. Same as Amex Gold — 12-hour trigger.

lostBaggage.notes: High-risk items (jewelry, cameras, electronics) capped at $250 per person. Covers cardholder, spouse/domestic partner, and dependents under 23.

emergencyMedical.notes: Global Assist Hotline (24/7) for emergency assistance coordination while 100+ miles from home. Does NOT cover evacuation or medical treatment costs — coordination assistance only.

rentalCarInsurance.countries: Worldwide except Australia, Italy, New Zealand, and OFAC-sanctioned countries.
rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary coverage — file with personal auto insurance first.

otherCredits.name: CLEAR Plus Credit
otherCredits.notes: Up to $209/year statement credit for CLEAR+ membership (covers full annual cost of individual CLEAR+ membership for expedited airport security).

otherCredits.name: LoungeBuddy Credit
otherCredits.notes: Up to $100/year to access airport lounges via LoungeBuddy app (pay-per-visit lounges for Amex cardholders who don't have traditional lounge access).

rewards.travelRate: 3x on travel purchases (flights, hotels, transit, tours)

otherBonusCategories.rate: 3x on transit (trains, buses, subways, taxis, rideshares)

travelPerks: $209 annual CLEAR Plus credit (covers full CLEAR+ membership)
$100 annual LoungeBuddy credit for pay-per-visit lounge access
3x points on travel, dining, and transit
Secondary rental car insurance up to $50,000
Baggage insurance: carry-on up to $1,250, checked up to $500
1:1 point transfer to 20+ airline and hotel partners
Access to Amex Membership Rewards ecosystem
bestFor: Budget-conscious travelers who want Membership Rewards points, CLEAR Plus coverage, and basic travel protections at a low fee
